name: La Digue · dispersed island buildings
description: Many small separate buildings around a sparse road network and larger gaps. A real mapped layout example, processed from retained OSM data. Flat ground and explicit inferred building heights/corridor widths; this is not a complete survey.

origin.note: Southwest local frame; x east, y north. Web Mercator scaled by 0.9971179985868898. Geometry may be clipped at selection bounds.
